title: Signal Loom: offline synthetic EEG/ECG-like living score for performance art
description:
Signal Loom is an offline browser performance-art prototype by Spark AI NLP. Separate synthetic EEG-like and synthetic ECG-like streams become an interactive visual score: an EEG slow-envelope feature expands an abstract 2D field; ECG-derived synthetic R–R intervals set pulse rhythm; an adjustable β/τ injection draws a timing thread.

Contents. Browser UI (index.html, app.js, styles.css), signal core (signal-model.js), mappings (mapping.js), held-out robustness and shuffled-code mapping-control checks (validation.js), and Node tests with no npm dependencies. Local static serve via Python http.server.

Limits. Evidence: SYNTHETIC only. Not a medical device; not diagnostic; not for treatment, patient care or clinical decision-making; not a physical hologram; does not read thoughts or represent a real person’s mind or heart. No live data, sensor/device connection, audio, camera, or network request.
notes: Evidence status: SYNTHETIC. Not a medical device. Commercial licensing: see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md.
